lines.text: Many learners say: You ought go to the doctor.
Better: You ought to go to the doctor.
Ought is always followed by to and the base verb.
Ought to! You ought to see a doctor.

data.wrong: You ought go to the doctor.
data.right: You ought to go to the doctor.
data.why: Ought is always followed by to and the base verb.
